entrypoints.resolve_run: p5_runner.resolve_run — no training, emits resolved config + all hashes
entrypoints.train_fold: p5_runner.train_fold — optimizer steps; synthetic fixtures only until authorization

resolved_runner_contract.folds: locked manifest pairs only (logits key never read); inner-val = deterministic 10% of outer-train, seeded per fold; outer-test asserted disjoint from train+val
resolved_runner_contract.checkpoint: MULTIHOT_MACRO_F1 on inner-val; test evaluated exactly once post-freeze
resolved_runner_contract.thresholds: per-class grid on inner-val only; zero-support classes excluded and reported

hashes.splits: fold manifest SHAs verified in validate_hashes (SOURCE_MANIFEST.json); resolved split_shas emitted per run by resolve_run

new_integration_tests: test_1_test_label_perturbation_invariance: outer-test label flip -> identical thresholds/checkpoint/val history
test_2_checkpoint_follows_macrof1_not_top1: controlled val sequence -> ep with best macro-F1 kept
test_3_runner_uses_locked_manifest: split == manifest pairs verbatim; tampered tensor -> LockViolation
test_5_refresh_epochs_exactly: real refresh path fires at ep 5,10 only; G objects change there
test_lock_rejects_diag_leak_and_missing: LockViolation on diag_leak=1 and missing lock section

corrected_assertion_coverage.test_pair_groups_all_types_together: was tautological; now asserts pair-index shape + atomic label masking
corrected_assertion_coverage.test_views_not_certified_clean: was empty pass; now machine-checks manifest UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE + exploratory verdict, fails on 'verified_clean'
corrected_assertion_coverage.test_post_refresh_view_sharing: was replicating assignment literal; now exercises the real train_fold refresh path (G objects compared live, with and without refresh)

feature_provenance_caveats: bundled sim_* views: UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE — exploratory claim ceiling, cannot be reported clean
P5_SPLIT_AWARE_EXTERNAL: BLOCKED_FEATURE_PROVENANCE pending MISIM upstream provenance
fold manifests contain stale logits: runner reads pairs/y only; logits never enter features or evaluation
remaining_blockers: evaluator convention for published joint P/R (Track R UNRESOLVED — permanent without author artifacts)
T1 post-refresh reading A vs B (A is implemented primary; B not executed)

proposed_g5_pilot.command: python -m p5_runner --once --fold 0 --seed 1234 --profile P5_BENCHMARK_UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE  (resolve_run + train_fold on fold 0, ~650 epochs CPU)

budget_estimate.wall_hours_est: 1.5-3h CPU (synthetic 40x30 fixture ~0.02s/epoch; real 411x271 roughly 30-100x heavier per epoch)
budget_estimate.acus_est: single session, one fold, one seed
budget_estimate.hard_cap: stop at first non-finite loss/grad or any leakage gate failure

claim_boundary: P5 interpretation only; not author-faithful; 0.8600 not a valid target
